## PURPOSE

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# PURPOSE
# ============================================================================
# Model Comparison Workflow:
#   1. Define global parameters and feature sets.
#   2. Train 8 diverse ML models on the SIPP donor sample.
#   3. Evaluate diagnostics across In-Sample, Out-of-Sample, and Drift contexts.
#   4. Validate thresholds on the target-like test set.
#   5. Score the ACS Target Sample with the winning model.
#   6. Generate Sanity Checks (Percentiles, Lift, Feature Importance).
#   7. Automatically export ONLY the highest-performing model and lock environment.
# ============================================================================

report_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
cat("Report rendered at:", report_timestamp, "\n")
```

## 1. SETUP & PATHS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 1. SETUP & PATHS
# ============================================================================
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(caret)
library(ROCR)
library(MLmetrics)
library(knitr)
library(pROC)

# Model Libraries
library(catboost)
library(xgboost)
library(lightgbm)
library(ranger)
library(ada)

# Paths
if (Sys.info()["sysname"] == "Windows") {
  base_dir <- "G:/Shared drives/Undocu Research"
} else {
  base_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-vsovero@ucr.edu/Shared drives/Undocu Research"
}

data_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Data")
ml_output_path <- here("ML Outputs")
dir.create(ml_output_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

acs_prediction_export <- file.path(ml_output_path, "ACS_SIPP_gbm.csv")
```

## 2. READ AND CLEAN BASE DATA

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 2. READ AND CLEAN BASE DATA
# ============================================================================
# DATA FILTERS APPLIED:
# 1. Base Universe: SIPP 2008 Wave 2 and ACS Target Sample
# 2. Age Constraint: 18 to 55 years old (Prime working age)
# 3. Employment: Currently employed (employed == 1)
# 4. Missingness: Dropped rows missing core demographic features
# 5. Target Variable: undocu_likely standardized to numeric 1 (Yes) or 0 (No)
# ============================================================================

sipp_file <- file.path(data_path, "(Step 1 output) Core_TM SIPP 2008 Wave 2.csv")
acs_file <- file.path(data_path, "ACS Target Sample.csv")

sipp_raw <- read_csv(sipp_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
acs_raw <- read_csv(acs_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

features <- c(
  "age", "fem", "married", "cit_spouse", "medicaid", "nonfluent",
  "spanish_hispanic_latino", "central_latino", "bpl_asia",
  "household_size", "poverty", "asian", "black", "white",
  "other_race", "years_us", "years_us_missing", "yrsed"
)

sipp <- sipp_raw %>%
  mutate(undocu_likely = ifelse(undocu_likely %in% c("X1", "1", 1), 1, 0)) %>%
  filter(age >= 18, age <= 55, employed == 1) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(features), undocu_likely)

acs <- acs_raw %>% drop_na(all_of(features))

# Split SIPP
set.seed(1)
train_index <- createDataPartition(sipp$undocu_likely, p = 0.70, list = FALSE)
sipp_train <- sipp[train_index, ]
sipp_test <- sipp[-train_index, ]

# Define Target-Like Validation Set
sipp_targetlike <- sipp_test %>%
  filter(employed == 1, age >= 22, age <= 55)
```

## 3. FORMAT DATA STRUCTURES FOR DIVERSE MODELS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 3. FORMAT DATA STRUCTURES FOR DIVERSE MODELS
# ============================================================================
# Extract features and targets
x_train <- sipp_train %>% select(all_of(features))
y_train_num <- as.numeric(sipp_train$undocu_likely)

x_valid <- sipp_targetlike %>% select(all_of(features))
y_valid_num <- as.numeric(sipp_targetlike$undocu_likely)

x_acs <- acs %>% select(all_of(features))

# A. CatBoost Pools
pool_train <- catboost.load_pool(data = x_train, label = y_train_num)
pool_valid <- catboost.load_pool(data = x_valid, label = y_valid_num)
pool_acs <- catboost.load_pool(data = x_acs)

# B. Caret Dataframes (Require Factor Targets)
caret_train <- x_train %>%
  mutate(undocu_likely = factor(
    y_train_num,
    levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Class1", "Class0")
  ))
caret_valid <- x_valid %>%
  mutate(undocu_likely = factor(
    y_valid_num,
    levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Class1", "Class0")
  ))
caret_acs <- x_acs

# C. One-Hot Matrices (XGBoost & LightGBM)
dummy_model <- dummyVars(~., data = x_train)
mat_train <- predict(dummy_model, newdata = x_train)
mat_valid <- predict(dummy_model, newdata = x_valid)
mat_acs <- predict(dummy_model, newdata = x_acs)

# XGBoost DMatrices
dtrain_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mat_train, label = y_train_num)
dvalid_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mat_valid, label = y_valid_num)
dacs_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mat_acs)

# LightGBM Datasets
lgb_train <- lgb.Dataset(data = mat_train, label = y_train_num)
```

## 4. TRAIN THE 8 MODELS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 4. TRAIN THE 8 MODELS (GRID SEARCH OPTIMIZED)
# ============================================================================
models <- list()
caret_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv", number = 5,
  summaryFunction = prSummary, classProbs = TRUE
)

# 1. CatBoost (Grid Search)
set.seed(1)
catboost_grid <- expand.grid(
  learning_rate = c(0.01, 0.05), depth = c(4, 6), l2_leaf_reg = c(3, 5)
)
best_cb_pr <- 0
best_cb_params <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(catboost_grid)) {
  cv_res <- catboost.cv(
    pool = pool_train,
    params = list(
      loss_function = "Logloss", eval_metric = "PRAUC",
      learning_rate = catboost_grid$learning_rate[i],
      depth = catboost_grid$depth[i],
      l2_leaf_reg = catboost_grid$l2_leaf_reg[i],
      iterations = 500, od_type = "Iter", od_wait = 50,
      logging_level = "Silent"
    ),
    fold_count = 5
  )
  if (max(cv_res$test.PRAUC.mean) > best_cb_pr) {
    best_cb_pr <- max(cv_res$test.PRAUC.mean)
    best_cb_params <- catboost_grid[i, ]
  }
}
models$CatBoost <- catboost.train(
  learn_pool = pool_train,
  params = list(
    loss_function = "Logloss", eval_metric = "PRAUC",
    learning_rate = best_cb_params$learning_rate,
    depth = best_cb_params$depth,
    l2_leaf_reg = best_cb_params$l2_leaf_reg,
    iterations = 500, logging_level = "Silent"
  )
)

# 2. XGBoost (Grid Search)
set.seed(1)
xgb_grid <- expand.grid(eta = c(0.01, 0.05), max_depth = c(4, 6))
best_xgb_pr <- 0
best_xgb_params <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(xgb_grid)) {
  cv_res <- xgb.cv(
    params = list(
      objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "aucpr",
      eta = xgb_grid$eta[i], max_depth = xgb_grid$max_depth[i]
    ),
    data = dtrain_xgb, nrounds = 500, nfold = 5,
    early_stopping_rounds = 50, maximize = TRUE, verbose = 0
  )
  best_iter_pr <- max(cv_res$evaluation_log$test_aucpr_mean)
  if (best_iter_pr > best_xgb_pr) {
    best_xgb_pr <- best_iter_pr
    best_xgb_params <- xgb_grid[i, ]
  }
}
models$XGBoost <- xgb.train(
  params = list(
    objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "aucpr",
    eta = best_xgb_params$eta, max_depth = best_xgb_params$max_depth
  ),
  data = dtrain_xgb, nrounds = 500, verbose = 0
)

# 3. LightGBM (Grid Search)
set.seed(1)
lgb_grid <- expand.grid(learning_rate = c(0.01, 0.05), num_leaves = c(15, 31))
best_lgb_pr <- 0
best_lgb_params <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(lgb_grid)) {
  cv_res <- lgb.cv(
    params = list(
      objective = "binary", metric = "average_precision",
      learning_rate = lgb_grid$learning_rate[i],
      num_leaves = lgb_grid$num_leaves[i]
    ),
    data = lgb_train, nrounds = 500, nfold = 5,
    early_stopping_rounds = 50, verbose = -1
  )
  if (cv_res$best_score > best_lgb_pr) {
    best_lgb_pr <- cv_res$best_score
    best_lgb_params <- lgb_grid[i, ]
  }
}
models$LightGBM <- lgb.train(
  params = list(
    objective = "binary", metric = "average_precision",
    learning_rate = best_lgb_params$learning_rate,
    num_leaves = best_lgb_params$num_leaves
  ),
  data = lgb_train, nrounds = 500, verbose = -1
)

# 4. Random Forest (ranger with tuneGrid)
set.seed(1)
models$`Random Forest` <- train(
  undocu_likely ~ .,
  data = caret_train, method = "ranger",
  metric = "AUC", trControl = caret_ctrl,
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(
    mtry = c(2, 4, 6), splitrule = "gini", min.node.size = c(1, 5)
  ),
  num.trees = 500, importance = "impurity"
)

# 5. Caret Models (GBM, GLM, KNN, AdaBoost) with Explicit Grids
set.seed(1)
models$GBM <- train(
  undocu_likely ~ .,
  data = caret_train,
  method = "gbm",
  metric = "AUC",
  trControl = caret_ctrl,
  verbose = FALSE,
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(
    n.trees = c(100, 300, 500),
    interaction.depth = c(3, 5, 7),
    shrinkage = c(0.01, 0.05),
    n.minobsinnode = c(10, 20)
  )
)

models$`Logistic Regression` <- train(
  undocu_likely ~ .,
  data = caret_train, method = "glmnet",
  metric = "AUC", trControl = caret_ctrl,
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(
    alpha = seq(0, 1, 0.5), lambda = 10^seq(-3, -1, length = 5)
  )
)

models$KNN <- train(
  undocu_likely ~ .,
  data = caret_train, method = "knn",
  metric = "AUC", trControl = caret_ctrl,
  preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(k = c(5, 9, 15, 21))
)

models$AdaBoost <- train(
  undocu_likely ~ .,
  data = caret_train, method = "ada",
  metric = "AUC", trControl = caret_ctrl,
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(
    iter = c(50, 100, 150), maxdepth = c(2, 4, 6), nu = c(0.01, 0.1, 1)
  )
)

cat("Successfully trained and grid-searched all 8 models.\\n")
```

## 5. DIAGNOSTICS: COMPREHENSIVE METRICS ACROSS CONTEXTS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 5. DIAGNOSTICS: COMPREHENSIVE METRICS ACROSS CONTEXTS
# ============================================================================

# 1. Shared Helper Functions for Predictions and Evaluation
generate_preds <- function(algo, model_obj, cat_pool, xgb_mat, lgb_mat, caret_df) {
  if (algo == "CatBoost") {
    return(catboost.predict(model_obj, cat_pool, prediction_type = "Probability"))
  }
  if (algo == "XGBoost") {
    return(predict(model_obj, newdata = xgb_mat))
  }
  if (algo == "LightGBM") {
    return(predict(model_obj, newdata = lgb_mat))
  }
  # Caret prediction method (Random Forest, GBM, GLM, KNN, AdaBoost)
  return(predict(model_obj, newdata = caret_df, type = "prob")[, "Class1"])
}

calc_brier <- function(preds, actuals) {
  mean((preds - actuals)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

calc_logloss <- function(preds, actuals) {
  eps <- 1e-15
  preds <- pmax(pmin(preds, 1 - eps), eps)
  -mean(actuals * log(preds) + (1 - actuals) * log(1 - preds), na.rm = TRUE)
}

calc_prauc <- function(preds, actuals) {
  perf_obj <- performance(prediction(preds, actuals), "prec", "rec")
  x <- perf_obj@x.values[[1]]
  y <- perf_obj@y.values[[1]]
  idx <- order(x)
  x <- x[idx]
  y <- y[idx]
  sum(diff(x) * (y[-1] + y[-length(y)]) / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# 2. Format full Out-of-Sample Test set
x_test <- sipp_test %>% select(all_of(features))
y_test_num <- as.numeric(sipp_test$undocu_likely)

pool_test <- catboost.load_pool(data = x_test, label = y_test_num)
caret_test <- x_test %>%
  mutate(undocu_likely = factor(
    y_test_num,
    levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Class1", "Class0")
  ))
mat_test <- predict(dummy_model, newdata = x_test)
dtest_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mat_test, label = y_test_num)

robustness_tracker <- data.frame()

# 3. Generate Diagnostics
for (algo in names(models)) {
  # Predict across contexts
  p_in <- generate_preds(
    algo, models[[algo]], pool_train, dtrain_xgb, mat_train, caret_train
  )
  p_out <- generate_preds(
    algo, models[[algo]], pool_test, dtest_xgb, mat_test, caret_test
  )
  p_drift <- generate_preds(
    algo, models[[algo]], pool_valid, dvalid_xgb, mat_valid, caret_valid
  )

  # Calculate Metrics
  robustness_tracker <- rbind(robustness_tracker, data.frame(
    Algorithm = algo,
    Drift_PRAUC = calc_prauc(p_drift, y_valid_num),
    Drift_ROCAUC = as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y_valid_num, p_drift, quiet = TRUE))),
    Drift_Brier = calc_brier(p_drift, y_valid_num),
    Drift_LogLoss = calc_logloss(p_drift, y_valid_num),
    Overfit_Penalty = calc_prauc(p_in, y_train_num) - calc_prauc(p_out, y_test_num),
    Shift_Penalty = calc_prauc(p_out, y_test_num) - calc_prauc(p_drift, y_valid_num)
  ))
}

robustness_tracker %>%
  arrange(desc(Drift_PRAUC)) %>%
  kable(digits = 4, caption = "Diagnostics (Sorted by Drift PR AUC)")
```

## 6. VALIDATE TARGET-LIKE SAMPLE & GENERATE THRESHOLDS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 6. VALIDATE TARGET-LIKE SAMPLE & GENERATE THRESHOLDS
# ============================================================================

val_results <- data.frame(
  Algorithm = character(),
  PR_AUC = numeric(),
  Threshold_75 = numeric()
)
thresholds <- list()

for (algo in names(models)) {
  # Predict on Target-Like validation set
  preds <- generate_preds(
    algo, models[[algo]], pool_valid, dvalid_xgb, mat_valid, caret_valid
  )

  pr_auc_score <- calc_prauc(preds, y_valid_num)

  # Calculate top 75% high-recall threshold
  valid_df <- tibble(p = preds, y = y_valid_num)
  t_75 <- min((valid_df %>%
    filter(y == 1) %>%
    arrange(desc(p)) %>%
    slice(1:floor(0.75 * n())))$p)

  val_results <- rbind(val_results, data.frame(
    Algorithm = algo, PR_AUC = pr_auc_score, Threshold_75 = t_75
  ))
  thresholds[[algo]] <- t_75
}

val_results <- val_results %>% arrange(desc(PR_AUC))
kable(val_results, digits = 4, caption = "Target-Like SIPP Validation Metrics")
```

## 7. SCORE ACS TARGET SAMPLE AND EXPORT DATA

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 7. SCORE ACS TARGET SAMPLE (WINNING MODEL ONLY)
# ============================================================================
best_model_name <- val_results$Algorithm[1]
cat("Scoring ACS dataset using the winning model:", best_model_name, "\\n")

acs_export <- acs %>% select(year, serial, pernum)

# Generate continuous probabilities for ACS using ONLY the best model
acs_probs <- generate_preds(
  best_model_name, models[[best_model_name]], pool_acs, dacs_xgb, mat_acs, caret_acs
)

acs_export$winning_model_p <- acs_probs
acs_export$winning_model_high_recall <- ifelse(
  acs_probs >= thresholds[[best_model_name]], 1, 0
)
```

## 8. DIAGNOSTIC SANITY CHECKS (WINNING MODEL)

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 8. DIAGNOSTIC SANITY CHECKS (WINNING MODEL)
# ============================================================================
# Generate SIPP predictions for the winning model to compare alongside ACS
p_test <- generate_preds(
  best_model_name, models[[best_model_name]], pool_test, dtest_xgb, mat_test, caret_test
)
p_valid <- generate_preds(
  best_model_name, models[[best_model_name]], pool_valid, dvalid_xgb, mat_valid, caret_valid
)

# --- Sanity Check 1: Probability Distribution Percentiles ---
# Aggressively shortened labels to prevent LaTeX PDF overlap
dist_acs <- tibble(Sample = "ACS", p = acs_probs)
dist_test <- tibble(Sample = "SIPP (All)", p = p_test)
dist_targetlike <- tibble(Sample = "SIPP (Target)", p = p_valid)

dist_all <- bind_rows(dist_acs, dist_test, dist_targetlike) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean = mean(p),
    P10 = quantile(p, 0.10),
    P25 = quantile(p, 0.25),
    P50 = quantile(p, 0.50),
    P75 = quantile(p, 0.75),
    P90 = quantile(p, 0.90)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, c("ACS", "SIPP (All)", "SIPP (Target)")))

kable(dist_all,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste("Sanity Check 1:", best_model_name, "Probability Distributions")
)


# --- Sanity Check 2: Target-Like SIPP Lift by Quartile ---
base_rate_val <- mean(y_valid_num)

lift_table <- tibble(p = p_valid, truth = y_valid_num) %>%
  mutate(quartile = ntile(p, 4)) %>%
  group_by(quartile) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Pos = sum(truth),
    Precision = mean(truth),
    Mean_P = mean(p)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Base_Rate = base_rate_val,
    Lift = Precision / Base_Rate,
    Q = paste0("Q", quartile)
  ) %>%
  select(Q, N, Pos, Precision, Mean_P, Base_Rate, Lift)

kable(lift_table,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste("Sanity Check 2:", best_model_name, "Lift by Quartile")
)


# --- Sanity Check 3: Dynamic Feature Importance ---
# Extracts feature importance dynamically with fallback
get_var_imp <- function(algo, model_obj, feature_names) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      # Force load gbm so Caret can find the relative.influence function
      require(gbm)

      if (algo == "CatBoost") {
        imp <- catboost.get_feature_importance(model_obj)
        return(
          tibble(Feature = feature_names, Importance = as.numeric(imp)) %>%
            arrange(desc(Importance))
        )
      } else if (algo == "XGBoost") {
        imp <- xgb.importance(feature_names = feature_names, model = model_obj)
        return(as_tibble(imp) %>% select(Feature, Importance = Gain))
      } else if (algo == "LightGBM") {
        imp <- lgb.importance(model_obj, percentage = TRUE)
        return(as_tibble(imp) %>% select(Feature, Importance = Gain))
      } else {
        # Caret models (RF, GBM, GLM, KNN, AdaBoost)
        imp_obj <- varImp(model_obj, scale = FALSE)
        imp_df <- imp_obj$importance
        imp_df$Feature <- rownames(imp_df)
        if ("Overall" %in% colnames(imp_df)) {
          res <- as_tibble(imp_df) %>% select(Feature, Importance = Overall)
        } else {
          res <- as_tibble(imp_df) %>% select(Feature, Importance = 1)
        }
        return(res %>% arrange(desc(Importance)))
      }
    },
    error = function(e) {
      return(tibble(Feature = c("Extraction Failed", e$message), Importance = NA))
    }
  )
}

top_features <- get_var_imp(best_model_name, models[[best_model_name]], features)
kable(head(top_features, 10),
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste("Sanity Check 3: Top Features for", best_model_name)
)
```

## 9. AUTOMATED SAVE AND ENVIRONMENT LOCKING

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 9. AUTOMATED SAVE AND ENVIRONMENT LOCKING
# ============================================================================

# 1. Export Data
write_csv(acs_export, acs_prediction_export)

# 2. Export ALL Models & Best Metadata
all_models_file <- file.path(ml_output_path, "all_optimized_models.rds")
best_metadata_file <- file.path(ml_output_path, "best_ml_metadata.rds")

final_metadata <- list(
  algorithm = best_model_name,
  report_timestamp = report_timestamp,
  features = features,
  pr_auc = val_results$PR_AUC[val_results$Algorithm == best_model_name],
  threshold_75 = thresholds[[best_model_name]]
)

# Saving the entire models list for later evaluation
saveRDS(models, all_models_file)
saveRDS(final_metadata, best_metadata_file)

# 3. Environment & Style Locking
renv::snapshot(prompt = FALSE)
styler::style_file("ML_Models.qmd")

tibble(
  Exported_Item = c("ACS Predictions", "All 8 Models Bundle", "Metadata"),
  Status = rep("Saved", 3)
) %>% kable()
```
